prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with crushed and creased sheet metal along the driver-side door panels and rocker area, with a bent B-pillar and a cracked side window frame. The pattern of deformation runs front to back and matches a side strike at an intersection as described. The proposed plan calls for replacing both front and rear doors, straightening the pillar, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the extent of this damage, and the parts list shows no duplicated line items. Nothing in the file points to prior damage on this unit, so the estimate is recommended as submitted.
